snippet.title: Radio Commander: Battle of Britain '40 | Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
A new game in the Radio Commander series has been announced, highlighting a new perspective on the Battle of Britain. In this RTS, players take command of RAF Fighter Command, not from the cockpit, nor flying, but from inside the operations room, making critical decisions based solely on radar readings, intelligence reports, and delayed communications. 

The game is a Radio Commander at heart, but with new exciting dynamics like resource management, deployment, fuel supplies, fatigue and morale, carrying with every decision strategic consequences.

The game will feature a full historical campaign spanning the opening stages of the German offensive through to the Blitz, delivering an immersive and historically grounded experience inspired by real RAF command center documentation and procedures.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556060/Radio_Commander_Battle_of_Britain_40/
